prompt: 9:16 vertical version, modern Oriental female dreamscape 3D papercut art, modern oriental papercut art, layered paper cut illustration, dimensional paper sculpture, intricate paper carving, paper diorama, layered shadow box, poetic female dreamscape, contemporary oriental art poster. The theme of the work is "She walks through the Bund to see the light on the other side of the Pujiang River." The core narrative is: a young Oriental woman standing on a paper-carved riverside promenade, the Pujiang River where night and morning light meet slowly unfolds before her. The Bund buildings and the Lujiazui skyline on the opposite side of the Pujiang River are lit up layer by layer in the glimmer, the city like a waking river of stars. She quietly gazes at the other shore, as if finally deciding to move from the familiar shore to a broader distance. The main character is an Oriental adult female with a visual age of about 25, clear-headed, independent, bright, and determined, with a sense of calm after urban growth. The character has a delicate oval face, bright almond eyes, and a calm and focused expression, like seeing the outline of the future. The character uses exquisite Oriental paper art illustration-style modeling, not real photo texture, not overly cartoonish. The character's hairstyle and headwear are: black long hair naturally scattered, the hair ends extending into streamlined paper bands, blown behind by the river wind, wearing light gold geometric leaves and small star point hair accessories, the headwear is exquisite and light, not complex or high. The character's clothing is: deep ultramarine and silver-white layered paper art long skirt, the inside of the skirt hem is engraved with the city skyline, water ripples, star points and building patterns, the outer shawl is thin and slender, the edges have dense hollowed-out patterns and paper art cutting feel. The skirt hem and shawl extend significantly backwards in the wind, forming elegant flowing lines, the clothing presents clear paper thickness, fiber texture, slight creases and high-completion manual cutting edges. The dream carrier is: paper art riverside promenade. Dream imagery includes: Bund buildings, Pujiang River, city skyline, promenades, bridges, shimmering star points. All buildings, river surfaces, railings, cloud layers, characters and decorations must be unified into a high-completion 3D paper carving language. The overall papercut structure adopts: paper page road type. The composition and character action are: a paper art riverside promenade extending along the river curves and extends from the foreground to the distance, the character is located in the lower middle left of the screen, with back or half-side back to the camera, standing quietly by the railing, facing the opposite skyline. The character is not an ordinary pose, but like gazing at the light on the other side. Long hair, skirt hem and shawl unfold backwards in the river wind, forming a consistent flow direction with the riverside promenade. Riverside railings, street lights, ground patterns and riverside arcs together lead the line of sight to the distant Lujiazui direction, forming a clear "riverbank-river surface-opposite skyline" depth space. The foreground is exquisite paper art riverside railings, flower branch decorations, lamp posts and road patterns; the middle ground is the curved and extended riverbank promenade and characters; the distance is the Pujiang River surface, ships on the river, Bund buildings and opposite city skyscrapers. Bund buildings must be paper-carved into Western-style facades, domes, clock towers, arched windows and continuous riverside building groups with obvious historical features; the Lujiazui skyline on the opposite side of the Pujiang River must also be paper-carved, clearly visible Oriental Pearl, Shanghai Tower, Shanghai World Financial Center and other iconic outlines, unfolding layer by layer with staggered paper-carved building groups. There can be a few paper-carved cruise ships on the river surface, as scale and dynamic embellishments. The overall color scheme is: mainly deep ultramarine, silver-white, champagne gold, with a small amount of coral red embellishment. Light and paper texture are: clear night light and soft sky morning light combined, city buildings and riverside promenades lit by fine lights, emphasizing real paper fiber, manual cutting marks, paper layer thickness, layered shadows and hollowed-out edge light transmission. Negative prompt: minors, young face, real photography, ordinary anime, plastic 3D, resin material, clay, felt, children's handmade, ordinary city night scene poster, realistic photography sense too strong, character and background material split, no paper layers, no hollow structures, chaotic paper layers, building identification too weak, Bund and Lujiazui not obvious, insufficient riverbank depth, character close-up too large, gray picture, dead black in dark parts, overall yellowish, overall bluish into a mass, elements messy piled up, text, logo, watermark.

promptZh: 9:16 竖屏版本，现代东方女性梦境 3D 剪纸艺术，现代东方剪纸艺术，分层纸艺插画，立体纸雕，精细纸刻，纸艺立体模型，分层影盒，诗意女性梦境，当代东方艺术海报。作品主题为“她走过外滩，看向浦江对岸的灯火”。核心叙事：一位年轻的东方女性站在纸雕的滨江步道上，黑夜与晨光交汇的浦江在她面前缓缓展开。浦江对岸的外滩建筑群与陆家嘴天际线在微光中层层点亮，城市宛如一条苏醒的星河。她静静地凝视着对岸，仿佛终于下定决心从熟悉的岸边走向更广阔的远方。主角是一位视觉年龄约 25 岁的东方成年女性，头脑清醒、独立、明亮且坚定，带有城市成长后的沉静感。角色拥有精致的鹅蛋脸，明亮的杏仁眼，神情平静而专注，如同看到了未来的轮廓。角色采用精致的东方纸艺插画风格建模，非真实照片质感，不过于卡通化。角色发型与头饰为：黑色长发自然散落，发梢延伸为流线型的纸带，被江风吹向身后，佩戴浅金色几何叶片与小星点发饰，头饰精致轻盈，不复杂高耸。角色服装为：深群青色与银白色分层纸艺长裙，裙摆内侧刻有城市天际线、水波纹、星点与建筑纹样，外披薄纱般纤细的披肩，边缘有密集的镂空花纹与纸艺切割感。裙摆与披肩在风中大幅向后延伸，形成优雅的流动线条，服装呈现出清晰的纸张厚度、纤维质感、轻微折痕与高完成度的手工切割边缘。梦境载体为：纸艺滨江步道。梦境意象包括：外滩建筑、浦江、城市天际线、步道、桥梁、闪烁的星点。所有建筑、江面、栏杆、云层、角色与装饰必须统一为高完成度的 3D 纸雕语言。整体剪纸结构采用：纸页路面式。构图与角色动作为：一条纸艺滨江步道沿江岸曲线延伸，从前景向远方铺展，角色位于画面左中下方，背对或半侧背对镜头，静静站在栏杆旁，面向对岸天际线。角色并非普通站姿，而是如同凝视对岸灯火。长发、裙摆与披肩在江风中向后展开，与滨江步道的流向保持一致。滨江栏杆、路灯、地面纹理与江岸弧线共同引导视线向远处的陆家嘴方向延伸，形成清晰的“江岸-江面-对岸天际线”深度空间。前景为精致的纸艺滨江栏杆、花枝装饰、灯柱与路面纹理；中景为弯曲延伸的江岸步道与角色；远景为浦江江面、江上船只、外滩建筑与对岸城市摩天大楼。外滩建筑必须纸雕化为西式立面、穹顶、钟楼、拱窗及具有明显历史特征的连续滨江建筑群；浦江对岸的陆家嘴天际线也必须纸雕化，清晰可见东方明珠、上海中心大厦、上海环球金融中心等标志性轮廓，与错落的纸雕建筑群层层展开。江面上可有少量纸雕游船，作为比例与动态点缀。整体配色方案为：以深群青、银白、香槟金为主，辅以少量珊瑚红点缀。光影与纸质表现：清晰的夜光与柔和的天空晨光结合，城市建筑与滨江步道被细微灯光点亮，强调真实的纸张纤维、手工切割痕迹、纸层厚度、分层阴影与镂空边缘的透光感。负面提示词：未成年人、幼态脸、真实摄影、普通动漫、塑料 3D、树脂材质、粘土、毛毡、儿童手工、普通城市夜景海报、写实摄影感过强、角色与背景材质割裂、无纸层、无镂空结构、纸层混乱、建筑识别度过弱、外滩与陆家嘴不明显、江岸深度不足、角色特写过大、画面灰暗、暗部死黑、整体发黄、整体发蓝成团、元素杂乱堆砌、文字、Logo、水印。
